description: Execute declared fixed-skeleton pose keyframes or fixed animation assets with one explicit root-transform owner, optional local pose overlay, hand/foot IK and head look, plus an explicit Chaos ragdoll transition.
physical_assumptions: A single harness UE mannequin, fixed bone/control set and versioned Control Rig define the articulated body.
Pose and root-transform sources are orthogonal, explicit declarations; no action-name routing or runtime fallback is allowed.
Animation clips come from the fixed mannequin bundle; Character Movement consumes an explicit root path.
Execution evidence is sampled at one UE post-tick time from capsule, root, bones, animation, Control Rig, movement, overlay, IK and head-look state.
Initial ground alignment changes only Z and only when a unique explicit support is available.
Chaos ragdoll starts only at the explicitly declared time and never as an automatic fallback.
verifier_rules: Validate articulated execution only from UE post-tick observed state; commanded trajectory is not execution evidence.
repair_suggestions: Correct the explicit pose/root source, fixed asset ID, standard bone/IK goal, keyframe timing or UE runtime binding.
